title: delphinium parryi subsp. seditiosum
intro: Delphinium parryi subsp. seditiosum, commonly known as Parry's delphinium or Mountain delphinium, is a plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. It is traditionally used as a medicinal herb, offering various health benefits such as relief from inflammation, pain, and fever. The plant's therapeutic actions include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Delphinium parryi subsp. seditiosum include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
